---
title: "Numbering hook"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(officequarto)
oq_numbering()
```

# Abbildungen

```{r}
#| label: fig-a
#| fig-cap: "FIG-A-CAP"
#| echo: false
plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-b
#| fig-cap: "FIG-B-CAP"
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 4
plot(3:1)
```

# Tabellen

```{r}
#| label: tbl-a
#| tbl-cap: "TBL-A-CAP with *emphasis*"
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(head(mtcars[, 1:3]))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-b
#| tbl-cap: "TBL-B-CAP"
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(head(mtcars[, 1:2]))
```

# Verweise

Siehe `r oq_ref("fig-a")` und `r oq_ref("fig-b")` sowie `r oq_ref("tbl-a")` und `r oq_ref("tbl-b")`.
